email.description: The user's email address. The event includes the user's email address only if the app used to request this event type includes the user:read:email scope for the user; otherwise, the field is set to an empty string. For a WebSocket subscription, the user access token you used to create the subscription must also belong to the user identified by user_id. The field is also an empty string if the user's account doesn't have an email address. See Create EventSub Subscription.

email_verified.description: A Boolean value that determines whether Twitch has verified the user's email address. Is true if Twitch has verified the email address; otherwise, false. NOTE: Ignore this field if the email field contains an empty string.

method.description: The transport method for EventSub. Possible values: webhook, websocket, conduit

callback.description: The callback URL where notifications are sent. The URL must use the HTTPS protocol and port 443, and its host must resolve to a public IPv4 address. Hosts that resolve only to IPv6 addresses aren't supported. See Processing an Event. Required if method is webhook. Don't specify it for other methods. NOTE: Redirects are not followed.

secret.description: The secret used to verify the signature. The secret must be an ASCII string that's a minimum of 10 characters long and a maximum of 100 characters long. For information about how the secret is used, see Verifying the event message. Required if method is webhook. Don't specify it for other methods.

session_id.description: An ID that identifies the WebSocket to send notifications to. When you connect to EventSub using WebSockets, the server returns the ID in the Welcome message. Required if method is websocket. Don't specify it for other methods.

conduit_id.description: An ID that identifies the conduit to send this notification to. When you create a conduit, the server returns the ID in the API response. Required if method is conduit. Don't specify it for other methods.

value.description: The monetary amount. The amount is specified in the currency's minor unit. For example, the minor units for USD is cents, so if the amount is $5.50 USD, value is set to 550.

decimal_places.description: The number of decimal places used by the currency. For example, USD uses two decimal places. Use this number to translate value from minor units to major units by using the formula: value / 10^decimal_places

currency.description: The ISO-4217 three-letter currency code that identifies the type of currency in value.

category.description: The category of the caught message.

level.description: The level of severity, from 1 to 4, where 1 is the most severe. AutoMod holds a message when its level is at or below the channel's AutoMod level for that category. Is 0 if AutoMod couldn't determine the category.

boundaries.description: The bounds of the text that caused the message to be caught.
